title: Ex-Mattel executive Krista Lee Berger takes global marketing role at Clinique
summary: The Estée Lauder Companies has appointed Krista Lee Berger as Senior Vice President, Global Marketing, Clinique. In this role, Berger will lead Clinique's global marketing strategy, drive breakthrough innovation and strengthen the brand's cultural relevance through modernized communications, the group said.
